name: smol machines
long_description:
Smol machines solve the problem of "but app works on my machine" by shipping the machine.

Smol machine enables devs to ship a lightweight virtual machine with any software, similar to how Electron ships an entire browser with the web app.
one_liner: Ship software faster with portable, self contained virtual machines.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Building the next generation cloud service that's like a baby of lambda and ec2. Using a new primitive that combines the isolation of a VM with speed and flexibility of containers.

Recently was at AWS.

Worked at ECS|Fargate|FargateOnFirecracker for ~4 years.
ECS is largest container service in the world.
Founding engineer of ECS managed instances.

Before that, spent another ~4years in Infra in startups, NASA.
Helped decomission Terra, Aqua, Aura satellites back into earth.
